body_lead: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: The much-vaunted ‘Safe Kerala’ initiative has hit a wall, with implementing agency Kerala State Electronics Development Corporation (Keltron) suspending its operation of the AI-enabled automated traffic enforcement system over massive dues. Processing of challans for violations detected on AI traffic cameras has been suspended for the last two weeks, pending a decision on the clearing of arrears amounting to Rs 60 crore.
